She gestures with her hands as she speaks directly to the camera. Behind her is a white slatted blind and a tube of 'soolantra' cream on a desk. (2) A quick cut to a meme-style video of a woman with curly hair and a shocked, questioning expression. (3) A brief shot of colorful SMPTE color bars, signaling a television-style transition. (6) The doctor is back on screen, now pointing upwards as she discusses the variety of antioxidants needed. Mathematical formulas appear briefly as graphic overlays to symbolize complex skin science. (7) A split-screen graphic shows a person's cheek with pigmentation alongside an animation of sun rays hitting skin. Large text '01 傳明酸' (Tranexamic Acid) appears as the first recommended ingredient. (9) The doctor holds up three fingers. The text '03 熊果素' (Arbutin) appears, followed by a final summary of whitening ingredients with 'bling-bling' star effects. (10) The video concludes with a static graphic featuring the DRX Dermatology Clinic logo, LINE ID, phone number, and address locations in Taipei.
